name: ReminisLink
description: Manage the ROMs, saves, save states, cheats and patches of your handheld from your iPhone, over your local Wi-Fi. Bring your own files.
author: Thomas Fournier

changelog.Unreleased:
New handhelds (experimental):
- Experimental, looking for testers: TrimUI Smart Pro S (tg5050), Anbernic H700 handhelds (h700) and Miyoo Flip (my355) with NextUI. Not tested on these devices yet: please report how it goes.
changelog.v1.0.2:
Fixes and small improvements:
- Installing from the Pak Store works: the release zip now holds the pak at its root (it was nested one folder too deep and did not start). Installing by hand: unzip, then copy the ReminisLink.pak folder into Tools/tg5040.
- French interface: a non-breaking space before colons, question marks and percent signs, as French typography wants.
- The presence check documents the oldest app this pak supports, so the app can say whether the app or ReminisLink on the handheld needs an update.
changelog.v1.0.1:
Maintenance release:
- Updated libraries (DNS for Bonjour, image) with their security fixes; the handheld behaves the same.
- The clock file of a save (.rtc) is documented and tested with every save operation: backed up and restored with the save, kept when a save is replaced, and moved to the trash when the game is deleted.
changelog.v1.0.0:
First release:
- Pair your iPhone with a QR code (no PIN). The connection is encrypted (HTTPS, pinned to the public-key fingerprint in the QR code); every request except the presence check and the pairing itself is signed. Several devices can be paired; your Apple devices share the pairing through iCloud Keychain.
- Pairings made with earlier test builds are deleted at the first launch: pair again by scanning the QR code (Settings > Pair a New Device).
- From the ReminisLink app: browse every game on the SD card, send games and box art, download any file of a game, back up and restore saves, lock save states, edit cheats and apply IPS, BPS and UPS patches.
- Manage the tools and emulators installed on the handheld (install from a zip, replace, remove) and browse the SD card (read only).
- The app updates live when the SD card changes and goes back to its list when you close ReminisLink.
- Nothing is deleted without a copy: deleted and replaced files go to a trash, purged at launch after 30 days of counted age.
- The handheld never connects to the internet.
- Interface in English and French.
